title: Correct normal force at B
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the normal force at point B as 70 N (or pressure exerted as 70 N).

title: Maximum distance on incline
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine the maximum sliding distance up the rough incline as 1.2 m.

title: Energy conservation to B
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply conservation of mechanical energy from point P to point B to find v_B^2.

title: Work-energy on incline
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the work-energy theorem for motion up the incline, accounting for gravity and friction.

title: Return energy analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should analyze energy changes during the return trip to determine if the slider reaches point A.

title: Correct conclusion about A
description: Essential Criteria: The student must conclude that the slider can slide out of point A after returning.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses incorrect signs for work done by gravity or friction on the incline.

title: Forgetting normal force components
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student omits either mg or centripetal force in the normal force calculation at B.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units (m, kg, s, N, J) throughout the solution.
